about: How each change of screen moves, written once for the app and checked on the website (web/tests/browser/motion.test.mjs). Owner, 12 Nov 2026: exactly as Apple's Weather app. Add a row for every new way between screens; 'web' is the motion the website test expects (null: changes straight away).

changes.what: Swipe sideways on a club page (website: also the arrow keys)

changes.app: PageJump.step: one club towards the tapped dot, sliding

changes.what: Run a finger along the page dots
changes.app: jumps to the club under the finger, no slide

changes.what: Pick a club in the list (phone)
changes.app: the list closes, the club shows straight away (zoom from the row: to do)

changes.what: Pick a club in the list beside the page (iPad, wide window)
changes.app: PageJump.go: the next club slides, further ones change straight away
